data.current_description:
Two ways to send content. Either PUT the bytes directly with the document's own content type (any type other than `application/json`), passing `expire_after_seconds` and `metadata[...]` as query parameters, or send `application/json` with a `source_url` for PrintSocket to fetch server side.

Source fetches are limited to publicly routable addresses: loopback, private and link-local destinations are refused at dial time and on every redirect hop.
data.description_suggestion: Uploads document content for reuse across multiple print jobs. Supports two submission methods: (1) Direct upload—send raw bytes with appropriate content type (not application/json) and pass `expire_after_seconds` and `metadata[...]` as query parameters, or (2) Source URL—send JSON with `source_url` for server-side fetch. Source URLs must be publicly routable; loopback, private, and link-local addresses are rejected at dial time and on all redirect hops. Returns a Document object with ID (prefixed `doc_`), expiration time (24 hours default), and metadata. Documents expire automatically and cannot be retrieved after expiration, but jobs referencing them continue printing.

data.current_description:
Two ways to send content. Either PUT the bytes directly with the document's own content type (any type other than `application/json`), passing `expire_after_seconds` and `metadata[...]` as query parameters, or send `application/json` with a `source_url` for PrintSocket to fetch server side.

Source fetches are limited to publicly routable addresses: loopback, private and link-local destinations are refused at dial time and on every redirect hop.
data.description_suggestion: Uploads document content for reuse across multiple print jobs. Supports two submission methods: (1) Direct upload—send raw bytes with appropriate content type (not application/json) and pass `expire_after_seconds` and `metadata` as query parameters, or (2) Source URL—send JSON with `source_url` for server-side fetch. Source URLs must be publicly routable; loopback, private, and link-local addresses are rejected at dial time and on all redirect hops. Returns a Document object with ID (prefixed `doc_`), expiration time (24 hours by default), and metadata. Documents expire automatically and cannot be retrieved after expiration, but jobs referencing them continue printing.
